'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**Impeding the [[Humanitarian aid|delivery of aid]] to [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]'s residents may be considered a crime within the jurisdiction of the [[International Criminal Court]], its top prosecutor has said. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/icc-prosecutor-rafah-border-crossing-says-hopes-visit-gaza-israel-2023-10-29/ (Reuters)]
**[[Reporters Without Borders]] says the killing of [[Reuters]] journalist Issam Abdallah in [[Lebanon]] earlier this month resulted from a deliberate strike from the direction of the [[Israel]]i border. [https://www.reuters.com/article/israel-palestinians-journalist-reporters-idINL8N3BZ0L2 (Reuters)]
**[[Save the Children]] says more children have been killed in Gaza during the war, than the total killed in conflicts around the world since 2019. At least 3,324 children have been killed in Gaza, while 36 have died in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/29/more-childrens-deaths-in-gaza-in-3-weeks-than-annual-total-since-2019-ngo (Al Jazeera)] 
**Two [[Mortar (weapon)|mortar shells]] hit a [[United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon|UN peacekeeper]] base in [[Hula, Lebanon|Hula]], [[Nabatieh Governorate]], [[Lebanon]], injuring a [[UN peacekeeper|peacekeeper]]. [https://www.wionews.com/world/un-peacekeeping-mission-hq-in-south-lebanon-hit-by-shell-2nd-such-incident-since-israel-hamas-war-652438 (WION)]
**At least 8,005 [[Palestinians]] have been killed in Gaza since October 7. More than 1,400 people were killed in [[Israel]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/28/israel-hamas-war-live-invasion-under-way-as-gaza-cut-off-from-the-world (Al Jazeera)] 
**Israel's [[Permanent Representative of Israel to the United Nations|ambassador]] to the [[United Nations]], [[Gilad Erdan]], calls on countries to cease funding the body after the [[UN General Assembly]] passed a non-binding resolution calling for an immediate [[ceasefire]] in Gaza. [https://www.tbsnews.net/features/panorama/israel-and-un-tricky-relationship-729322 (The Business Standard)]
**[[Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] says the war will be "long and difficult", with Israel intensifying its [[airstrike]]s and progressing to the "next phase" of operations. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/live-blog/israel-hamas-war-live-airstrikes-gaza-ground-operation-rcna122596 (NBC News)]
**The [[Legal Center for Arab Minority Rights]] in Israel demands that [[Israel's government]] cancel emergency regulations extending the period which detainees suspected of "security offences" can be [[Right to counsel|denied access to a lawyer]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/28/israel-hamas-war-live-invasion-under-way-as-gaza-cut-off-from-the-world (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[2023 Kerala bombing]]
**A [[improvised explosive device|bomb]] [[explode]]s during a [[Jehovah's Witnesses]]' convention at the Zamra International Convention Center in [[Kalamassery]], [[Kerala]], [[South India]], killing two people and injuring around 40 others. A man claiming responsibility for the bombing surrenders to [[Kerala Police|police]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/one-killed-several-injured-explosions-indias-southern-state-local-media-2023-10-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Hezbollah launches missiles and shelling attacks on 19 IDF military sites.[url=https://www.understandingwar.org/backgrounder/iran-update-october-29-2023 (UnderstandingWar)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***[[Russia]] says that it has shot down 36 [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[unmanned aerial vehicles|drones]] over the [[Black Sea]] and the [[Crimea]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates-russia-says-36-drones-downed-over-black-sea/live-67246886 (DW)]
*A person is killed and three more people are injured during a [[rocket]] attack by the [[Polisario Front]] in [[Smara]], in the [[Morocco]]-occupied [[Western Sahara]]. [https://www.middle-east-online.com/en/morocco-probes-deadly-projectile-firing-es-smara (Middle East Online)]

'''Disasters and incidents'''
*[[2023 Pacific hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Otis]]
***The [[Mexican government]] reports that at least 48 people were killed.  Most of them in [[Acapulco]], [[Guerrero]]. The government also reports widespread flooding, significant infrastructure damage, and aid has been slow to arrive.  [https://www.npr.org/2023/10/29/1209316931/hurricane-otis-death-toll-rises-to-39-as-searchers-comb-through-debris-in-acapul (AFP via The Journal)]
*[[2023 Rio Branco plane crash]]
**A [[plane crash]] in [[Rio Branco, Acre|Rio Branco]], [[Acre (state)|Acre]], [[Brazil]], kills 12 people. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-plane-crash-fc487d48956faff6f842f6e80a05f7c7 (AP)]
*[[2023 Andhra Pradesh train collision]]
**Fourteen people are killed and 50 others are injured when two [[passenger train|passenger]] [[Train wreck|trains collide]] in [[Andhra Pradesh]], [[India]]. Human error is reported as the cause of the collision. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/andhra-pradesh-train-accident-live-updates-9-killed-40-injured-as-2-trains-collide-in-andhra-4526421 (NDTV)]
*The [[United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees]] reports that nine [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|migrants]] have died in the [[Mediterranean Sea]] while heading to [[Italy]] from [[North Africa]], with five of the bodies found on the coast of [[Sicily]] and four of the bodies recovered by the [[non-governmental organization]] [[Sea-Eye]]. [https://tribune.net.ph/2023/10/nine-migrants-crossing-to-italy-found-dead-in-mediterranean/ (AFP via ''Daily Tribune'')]

***Antisemitic threats are made toward Jewish students at [[Cornell University]] in [[Ithaca, New York|Ithaca]], [[New York (state)|New York]], U.S. [https://www.localsyr.com/news/local-news/antisemitic-threats-made-against-cornell-university-jewish-community/amp/ (WSYR-TV)]
*[[Hijab and burka controversies in Europe]]
**The [[National Council (Switzerland)|National Council]] of [[Switzerland]] votes 151–29 to approve a ban on full-face coverings, such as [[burqa]]s worn by a small minority of [[Islam in Switzerland|Muslim]] women. Violators of the ban could face a fine of up to 1,000 [[Swiss franc]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/switzerland-burqa-niqab-face-covering-ban-fine-4a4392a28498618ca0c59e290fe10a36 (AP)]
*[[Iranian protests against compulsory hijab]]
**[[Human rights in Iran|Human rights]] lawyer [[Nasrin Sotoudeh]] is arrested at the funeral of 17-year-old [[Death of Armita Geravand|Armita Geravand]] in [[Tehran]] for not wearing a [[headscarf]], according to local media. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2400391/middle-east (AFP via ''Arab News'')]
*[[Bangladesh Nationalist Party]] [[secretary general]] [[Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir]] and at least 164 party members are [[criminal charge|charged]] with the [[murder]] of a [[Bangladesh Police|police]] officer during recent [[2024 Bangladeshi general election|election]]-related [[political demonstration|demonstrations]]. [https://tribune.net.ph/2023/10/bangladesh-charges-opposition-party-leadership-with-murder/ (AFP via ''Daily Tribune'')]
